_sample_note: Sample 02 (reference suite): glob-filtered ZIP ingestion, all assets isolated in the {{catalog}}.flowx_sample schema. The seed notebook (notebooks/00_seed_sample_data/04_seed_sample_02_zip_ingestion_data.py) builds one ZIP archive per iteration IN-PROCESS (never a pre-built .zip fixture -- workspace-bundle sync can mangle binary uploads) from a distinct samples.tpch.orders slice, and deliberately injects a few rows with a NULL customer_id per iteration so the quarantine DQ rule visibly routes them into sample_zip_orders_raw_quarantine instead of the clean table (order_id stays populated on those rows -- it is the record_id_column that identifies each quarantined record). source_zip_handling extracts only archives matching sample_orders_*.zip from the incoming landing directory into the extracted directory Auto Loader actually reads; delete_source_after_extract is false so a developer can inspect the original archives after a run.

ingestion_flows.source_description: Sample 02: per-iteration ZIP archives (sample_orders_iter1..3.zip, built in-process by the seed notebook from distinct samples.tpch.orders slices) are extracted by source_zip_handling and the contained CSV is Auto Loader-ingested into an APPEND streaming table. Each iteration's CSV carries 3 deliberately broken rows (NULL customer_id) that the quarantine rule routes to sample_zip_orders_raw_quarantine.
